reviewer: Pickle: official-source snow chain / winter traction device comparison guide
method: Reviewed the full draft against 14 source URLs, all returning HTTP 200 on 2026-11-03 (13 verified by curl before writing; the Hyundai Tucson 2025 manual URL corrected to the working variant and re-verified). Braking-distance core: TS한국교통안전공단 measured a passenger car at 30 km/h stopping in 10.7 m on ice vs 1.5 m dry (7x), truck 2.7->12.4 m (4.6x), bus 3.6->17.5 m (4.9x), and a bus at 60 km/h needing 118.7 m vs 16.2 m dry (Yonhap 2026-01-19 and 2021-12-17 reports of the official Hwaseong test). Fatality data: KOTSA release 2025-02-12 (TAAS 2019-2023: 3,944 icy-road crashes, 95 deaths, fatality rate 2.4 vs 1.4 = 1.7x, ice 2.3x worse than snow cover, tire pressure at 80%+ of spec, brake pumping 2-3 times); Yonhap 2026-01-19 (TAAS 2022-2024: frost/ice fatality rate 1.97 vs 1.27 dry, +55%); KoROAD big-data via Financial News 2022-12-08 (4,932 icy crashes, 73.2% in Dec-Jan, fatality rate 2.5 vs 1.6, 38% between 06-10 h, highway icy fatality 16.1 = 3x, 62 hotspots incl. 18 bridges/viaducts and 8 tunnels). Legal: Road Traffic Act Enforcement Rule Art.19(2) via the National Law Information Center - 20% speed reduction under 20 mm of snow, 50% when frozen or 20 mm+, 50% under 100 m visibility; no nationwide chain-mandatory article, chain requirements activate through road-authority traffic controls (MoIS/기상청 action guides). Textile chains: AutoSock official - 3-minute fitting, first product certified to EN 16662-1:2020, certification requires 120 km on dry asphalt without safety-relevant damage, legal chain alternative across the EU except Austria and in Switzerland/Norway since 2020-12-01 for vehicles under 3.5 t; Hyundai/Kia manuals explicitly allow fabric chains, with Kia allowing wire chains 15 mm or thinner (12 mm on other models) and Hyundai restricting 235/60R18 and 235/55R19 to fabric chains only, plus 30 km/h limit and 0.5-1 km re-tensioning check; Kia bans chains on 215/50R19 and 245/40R20. Chains vs socks on-ice: Tyre Reviews 2023 measured snow traction socks 3.5 s vs chains 3.7 s, snow braking chains 44.4 ft (13.5 m) vs socks 46.5 ft (14.2 m), chains dominant on ice while socks barely beat all-season tires. Spray: ADAC 2011 group test judged the spray (Snow Grip) deficient because it wears off within a few hundred meters; steel chains took the top overall grade (1.8), AutoSock satisfactory, Michelin Easy Grip 2.4. Winter tires: Hankook Tire measured snow braking at 40 km/h of 18.49 m winter vs 37.84 m all-season, ice braking at 20 km/h 14% shorter, winter surface 4-8x more slippery, rubber stiffens below 7 C, tread wear limit 1.6 mm. Coupang verification: all three ranked products opened in-browser on 2026-11-03 with prices, review counts and shipping confirmed (AutoSock fabric 697 model product 6214702934 - 115,000 won, 17 reviews, free shipping ships today; TaeYoung auto urethane chain size 4 product 48165321 - 100,000 won less 39% = 60,160 won, 487 reviews, 50 km/h limit; Bullson RainOK NEW spray chain 500 ml x2 product 7701295051 - 21,900 won less 24% = 16,460 won, 4,533 reviews), and the three freshly issued partner deep links redirect to the correct product IDs with lptag=AF6593875. Kakao Gift curator links (9% commission) verified HTTP 200: I'mVita Immune Shot 10p + lucky-charm keycap 27,900 won -> gift-link.kakao.com/c/scq1Oivc; Danmi dual hand-warmer power bank 36,800 won -> gift-link.kakao.com/c/4wmjoO73; Osulloc Premium Tea Collection 25,600 won -> gift-link.kakao.com/c/bFGXVyDC. Plan deviations: (1) the plan's hook figure '제동거리 7.7배' does not match the official experiment - the KOTSA test gives 7x for a passenger car at 30 km/h (10.7 m vs 1.5 m), so the body uses the verified 7x and the Korea Tire 4-8x slipperiness range; (2) the plan's '카렉스 프리미엄 우레탄 스파이크 스노우체인' was mapped to the actual best-selling urethane product from the same maker (태영 자동 우레탄 스노우체인, 487 reviews) because the spike variant has no review base, and the tag was set to the shipping status actually shown (무료배송·오늘출발) rather than 로켓배송; (3) no-image post (text+tables only) as in recent guides; the 9% curator expected revenues (2,511/3,312/2,304 won) are recorded here and in the research file, not shown in the reader-facing gift section.
